title: Listening Drill — Checking a rain gauge
description: Practical demonstration. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Checking a rain gauge
sections.transcript:
INSTRUCTOR: This demonstration is about checking a rain gauge. Watch the whole process once before trying it yourself. If you start while I'm still talking, you may miss the order of the steps.

INSTRUCTOR: Get the measuring jug ready. Begin by checking the level base. When everything is in position, wait three minutes. It may look as though nothing is happening at first.

INSTRUCTOR: Look for a steady reading before moving on. don't tighten the bolts while measuring. Leave yourself time to clear the work area so the next group can start promptly.
